items.question: By what numerical scope is the claim made that certain beings endure torment within womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant units.
Those units are located among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings within those units are described as tormented.
items.inference: Torment is assigned to beings situated within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings remains unspecified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
